messages:
sara: Quick thread to lock down a lightweight DP commitment + activation playbook we can share with sales and execs. Aim: one page, measurable, reversible.

isaac: Love it. My ask: include a clear "time to first meaningful outcome" metric so sales can promise something specific (e.g., first successful workflow in X days).

ravi: From eng POV, make the activation step automated: partner runs a prebuilt smoke job that proves end-to-end. If it passes, mark as 'activated'.

mei: From CS: partners care about predictable touchpoints. Recommend standard cadence: week 0 onboarding call, weekly 30m for 3 weeks, then biweekly. Spell that out in the doc.

lex: Legal: short line for invites re data handling + export window. For private installs add KMS handling note. Keep it one sentence.

ops-bot: automation templates: /ops/templates/dp-activate-smoke.yml and /ops/templates/dp-onboard-invite.md. Can automate cadence invites when smoke pass recorded.

sara: Draft playbook sections I propose: 1) Recruitment gates (scorecard + SOW), 2) Activation (smoke job + demo), 3) Feedback obligations (structured evals), 4) Ops & legal, 5) Exit/rehab flow.

isaac: Suggest thresholds: activation = smoke job pass + demo within 10 business days; engagement = >=2 active sessions/week OR >=15 API calls/week for 3/4 weeks; feedback = 1 structured eval/sprint.

ravi: Add a 7-day grace after any platform update before we evaluate regressions to avoid false positives. Also weight regressions by severity.

mei: Rehab flow: if partner falls below engagement, auto-trigger an outreach; if no recovery in 7 days, issue notice and pause access; archive data for 30 days. If partner does 2 consecutive good weeks within archive window, restore access.

lex: I'll draft the one-sentence legal blurb: "We retain trial data for 30 days after pause; customers on private installs should contact support for KMS key export instructions."

isaac: One tiny implementation ask: add a DP tag on partner accounts so we can filter metrics and avoid noise. Ops, possible? @ops-bot

ops-bot: yes, can add `dp_cohort` tag and scaffold a dashboard. Need metric owners for sessions and api_calls.

mei: Who owns the doc? I can shepherd edits for CS input. Sara do you want to finalize the slide?

sara: I'll assemble the one-pager and a tiny slide. Owners: sara (slide + playbook), isaac (activation smoke + FF), ravi (regression weighting & grace window), mei (cadence & rehab wording), lex (legal blurb), ops (tag + dashboard). Target: circulate by Thu COB.

isaac: :thumbsup: I'll prototype the smoke job and post link.

mei: :thumbsup: will add the partner cadence template.

lex: :thumbsup: legal blurb by Wed AM.

sara: Great — I'll post the draft in /product/dp-activation-playbook.md and ping this thread when it's ready. Thanks everyone!
